user_text: I see the more common feedback can be send to GEPA especially this feedback will affect the whole system in the long run. But for some specific feedback regarding to a particular report and a specific agent, the instruct should be send to an agent directly

decision.reusable_feedback: Capture in learning intake for potential GEPA optimization and longer-term reusable guidance.
decision.report_and_agent_specific_feedback: Deliver as a current instruction to the relevant agent for that report.
decision.scope: Generality does not automatically expand customer/project applicability to global policy.
decision.dual_applicability: When feedback both corrects the current report and provides a reusable lesson, current execution and durable learning capture can both apply.
